name: dumbbell single stiff leg deadlift
description: A single leg hinge holding a dumbbell, which trains your hamstrings, glutes and balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand or both hands.
Keep a soft bend in your standing knee.
Hinge forward while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower the dumbbell toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to stand back up, then switch legs.
